Container.Name: steep
Container.Overview: Steep: a calm, self-hosted RSS reader. Full-text extraction for teaser feeds, OPML import/export, light and dark themes, and an installable web app for iPhone and iPad.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Steep web interface.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, settings and generated password live here. Back this up.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: Sign-in password. If left blank, one is generated and saved to initial_password.txt in appdata.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the appdata files.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the appdata files.

Config.Name: Fetch concurrency
Config.Description: How many feeds to fetch at once.

Config.Name: Default refresh (minutes)
Config.Description: How often each feed is checked unless set per feed. Minimum 5.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy auth header
Config.Description: Optional. If a reverse proxy authenticates you and sets a header (for example Remote-User), put its name here to skip Steep's own sign-in. Only use this if the port is not reachable except through that proxy.
